<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reports/value-recovery"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The value recovered by RESTOCK dispositions: lines and units staged
per site per UTC day over `from`/`to`. Omitted bounds default to the 30
days ending now; the window is at most 366 days. A bounded report: it
does not page.
